answer: A proof-of-space scheme curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to allocate dedicated sectors on ferrous storage drives to retain cryptographic plotting tables. Nodes prove legitimacy by answering spatial challenges broadcast over a whisper protocol, linking verified status to a sequential vine of state checkpoints. An adversary incurs real capital costs purchasing scarce non-volatile storage per identity. However, this defense favors entities that can exploit idle enterprise storage arrays.
